reuse.why: Extends the single existing isNonWorkingDay check through a small isHoliday helper, reusing monthUtils.dayFromDate and date-fns format already imported.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; holiday matching lives in one function.

placement.why: The change sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend/holiday rule that every date path already uses.

scope.why: Only the holiday matcher and its tests are changed.

maintainability.why: A clearly named helper with two readable conditions; easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: None; all holiday checks go through isNonWorkingDay.
